logic.description: Class permanent, user ruling 2026-10-30; ability re-ruled 2026-11-14. Colours: W (souls), Wi (concentration/harmony). Destroyed colour by colour (adjacent enemy emits one of its elements, die of 6, one per action, any order) → archive; recast / untap by emitting every colour (any successful roll). Ability (tap, user ruling 2026-11-14 "create a new one, the same as the nearby building, on a nearby location chosen by you next to you (if not chosen a random location near you)"): the building nearest to me within data.near (2) hexes — a catalogue / created map building (js/features.js isBuildingFeature: no tree, grove, wall, bridge; a broken fortress no longer counts), distance then q then r, the one under me included — is COPIED: same look, and the same bonus (js/building-bonus.js rolls the copy on its source hex: same stat bonus and power; a copy of a copy points at the first source). The copy rises on the hex I clicked if it lies data.place_range (1) from me and is free, else on a random free hex next to me. A free hex is walkable and holds no feature of its own (building, dungeon, tree, labyrinth wall — created buildings included), no obstacle, no standing fortress, no living unit after the action's moves, and no other building raised in the same action; never the creator's own hex. Random pick: sha256 over `${salt}:<class>:${action}` modulo the (q, r)-sorted free hexes — the same on every peer. No building within data.near or no free hex → nothing happens and the card stays untapped. The creator records the building as the world edit `made:q,r` {q, r, made, at} in its world_edits_json (snapshot); every peer folds all such edits of its resolution view into the js/features.js overlay before resolving (peer.mjs syncPlacedBuildings; browser main.js syncPlacedBuildings from the roster), so featureAt / buildingBonusAt / the renderer / object cards treat it as a map building from the next action on (first `at` per hex wins, then the creator id). Traps (user ruling 2026-11-15, "They are carrying traps"): the copy hides the trap its SOURCE building would hide — peer.mjs worldTrapAt rolls the source hex (copy_of; same 35% chance, same effect) and arms it fresh on the copy's own hex (id `wtrap:<copy hex>`), whether or not the source's trap has sprung or been disabled; springing / disabling one never touches the other. A copied dungeon is a dungeon of its own (`dng:<copy hex>`), unexplored when it rises, holding the trap its source would hold (dungeonTrap rolls the source hex). Rogue's trap charge, the Cleric's passive (step onto a trapped building) and tap (disable within 3) treat the copy like any trapped building. Traps laid by players on the source tile are cards of their owners and are not copied. A copy of a Priest's Shrine keeps the Shrine's fixed bonus (mend, no stat) and, like every Shrine, hides no trap. peer.mjs: animatorCopy + createBuilding; pure helpers game/class-world.mjs nearestBuilding / buildSite / copyMade (oracles tools/fortress-check.mjs).

logic.description: Class permanent, user rework 2026-11-14 (version 1.1.0). Colours: W (souls), M (air), Wi (concentration/harmony); destroyed colour by colour → archive, recast by emitting every colour (unchanged). Ability: PASSIVE, once per turn (hg.turn = 3 actions), no click. The first time in a turn the Manipulator is about to take COMBAT damage (a positive Attack / Block / Posture strike of the damage matrix in the main action — not bonus rounds, spells, traps, tokens or combos) the ability fires by itself and is spent until the next turn. A random enemy within range (3 hexes, pre-action tiles; index = sha(Manipulator's reveal salt : turn.action) mod the sorted candidates) returns its revealed Action — and every skill riding on it, Battle Trance included — to its hand and plays another Action card from its hand instead; it may be the same kind. A non-instant cast or a Rule 24 emission survives only if the new action still emits (P/EP, Reaver A, Monk M/EM); an interrupted cast is discarded (Rule 19). The round is then resolved again with the swap. Determinism: hands are private, so every unit within publish_range (6) of an enemy Manipulator commits `manip_alt` = one random OTHER Action card of its hand (Empty Posture when it has none), part of the commit hash; candidates without it cannot be picked. The ability is only spent when a swap happens. Code: game/class-manipulator.mjs, peer.mjs doPlanningEnd (manip_alt) and doResolution (probe + swap).
